name: analytics-page-fix
goal: Analytics loads in the installed reports website and shows loop, Jev and model usage

evidence: Large analytics histories produce truncated JSON and HTTP 500; website must parse complete subprocess output.
Real CLI fixture with 4000 events failed JSON parsing at 65536 bytes; unchanged route regression expected HTTP 200 and received 500. Inspected route-before.png.
CLI awaits stdout write completion; website waits for subprocess close after streams drain.
Same large-response test passed; same browser route test passed HTTP 200. Inspected route-after.png showing Analytics scaffold; dashboard design remains blocked until Claude reset.
